subject: MAP draft: confirm milestone owners, dependencies, and close-window options
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft: confirm milestone owners, dependencies, and close-window options

Alex — great to meet on the call this morning. Thanks for the context on volume and the PHI flows. Per our discovery, I’ve attached an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) you can review. This is an initial draft to get shared ownership aligned and make progress toward a target close.

Attached: MAP_draft_v0.1.xlsx, SOW_template_redwood.pdf (stubs)

High-level milestones (proposed owners):
- Kickoff & tech discovery (Week 0): Alex / ClearView IT (owner: Alex Rivera)
- Security review & attestation (Week 1–3): ClearView Security + Redwood Compliance (owner: Maria Gomez, TBD)
- Integration spike (Week 2–6): Redwood SE (owner: Connor O'Brien)
- Pilot data ingestion & evaluation (Week 4–10): ClearView Data Team (owner: ClearView)
- Final sign-off & procurement (Week 8–12): Procurement/legal (owner: Alex + Redwood Sales)

Dependencies called out in the draft: SOC2 evidence, SAML/SSO configuration, API key access for pilot, PHI ingestion approval from Legal.

Target close-window options (pick one):
A) Aggressive: 6–8 weeks from kickoff (good if SOC2 evidence can be shared quickly and API access granted immediately)
B) Conservative: 10–12 weeks (recommended if security approvals take longer or pilot scope grows)

Please: 1) Confirm the ClearView stakeholders for each milestone (I put tentative owners in the MAP), 2) Tell us which close-window you prefer, and 3) Identify any additional dependencies we missed.

Next steps I’ll take if I don’t hear back in 48 hours: schedule a 30-min follow-up to lock owners and pick a target close.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@clearviewhealth.com>

Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft: confirm milestone owners, dependencies, and close-window options

Kimberly — thanks for the concise summary and the draft. A few quick items from our side after a fast sync with IT and Security: 

1) Please add Maria Gomez (maria.gomez@clearviewhealth.com) as the security lead on the MAP; she’ll own the SOC2 evidence intake and the security checklist.
2) We have a mandatory PHI ingestion approval that must be signed by our legal/privacy office before pilot ingestion — I’ve added that as a dependency.
3) For target close, we prefer a mid-November window (roughly Oct 25–Nov 15). So option B (10–12 weeks) aligns better for us given internal approvals.
4) Connor — can you confirm API auth patterns? We typically want service-account-based tokens and a staging endpoint for the pilot.

I’ve attached an internal security intake form we usually require (not included in the stubbed attachments here).

If you can update the MAP with Maria as security owner, add PHI approval as a blocker, and mark Option B as our preferred close-window, we can route this internally and get back with firm stakeholder names and a legal review ETA.

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Director of Product Integrations | ClearView Health
alex.rivera@clearviewhealth.com
+1 (617) 555-0123
